purpose: establish whether the pre-registered design is feasible; document the amendment committed before the confirmatory run

finding_1_shipped_strength_degenerate.evidence: the shipped suite's own exp1 smoke output at t=0 (cuda_reference/cuda_smoke_exp1.json; same at the MLX port)
finding_1_shipped_strength_degenerate.consequence: the fees-only arm at shipped strengths sits in a degenerate corner (near-zero enrolment, near-one visible work); a non-degenerate tie-breaker test is impossible there

finding_2_shipped_strength_unmatchable.probe: theta_0 = centroid of shipped DGP vectors; mechanism scale K=0.5 of the shipped deviation; 6 nuisance knobs; target = theta_0 moments at default nuisance
finding_2_shipped_strength_unmatchable.result: best max|residual| over 6 moments: P 0.027, S 0.222, C 0.063 (S cannot reach the baseline because its shifted w_push/w_tutor keep it out of schooling); at K=1 (shipped) the S world's post-shock GER is ~0.03
finding_2_shipped_strength_unmatchable.consequence: worlds are not macro-matchable at shipped strengths; H4's conditional design cannot run

finding_3_moderate_strength_matched_at_5.probe: theta_0 = centroid; K=0.20; 9 nuisance knobs; 400 seeded candidates; target = theta_0 moments at design nuisance D (below)
finding_3_moderate_strength_matched_at_5.consequence: all three worlds are macro-matchable at a +/-0.05 absolute tolerance; the tolerance is widened from 0.02 to 0.05 for this design (declared)
